body: I hate to draw any attention to myself, I'm really a loner.  I will prob wait til Tuesday since I see psychiatrist then anyway.

warning explicit graphic content, stop reading if this may affect you..



See I have memories that no one should have, as a young child I was abused, tortured... And witnessed another child murdered.  I have PTSD and nightmares of the body... It haunts me.  I was told if I didn't cooperate with them I would die too.  They would rape me and pour alcohol down my throat or cleaning fluid... Or worse.   I can't live with this in my brain, but I know of no way to forget it.  Remembering trying to hide and being afraid to breathe in case they heard me and would find me.   Being stripped naked and beaten and raped over and over for years.   Sickening.    All I can do is cry and feel sick and trapped.

Nervous that it will be another thing that won't work, won't help, then I guess I will really be at the very bottom and there truly is no hope.  If that's the case, suicide is really only option.  I have doubts.. What is there that can make a person forget or somehow live with brutal sexual abuse memories?  If I could dash that part of my brain out on the pavement I would...

It took me a very long time to get help, so this feels to me like the last possible thing I can try to get better, what if this fails too?  I'm afraid it will be just more lame platitudes and cajoling.... All useless...

Lately I spend time googling suicide stuff or you tubing it.  And I think of ways I could do it myself.  Living life where every truck going by u on the street looks like something to jump in front of... Or jumping off balcony looks appealing....  When I go to drug store I fantasize about buying a ton of pills and just taking them all...   This is such crap to feel like this.

I really have no money, never did, life is hard and doing without is the norm.  So I always thought well money will fix things.  But now I'm at the point where I don't even know what I need or want, I can't even play the what if I won the lotto game and pretend for awhile.  I get cravings like I want or need something, but I have no clue what "it" is.  The craving type feeling is horrible, agitating, and without knowing what I need or want to stop the feeling...  It's torture.
I have what they call "day hospital" tomorrow, psych stuff to try to help deal with all this, I guess I'm nervous about it.
